characters.name: Zeca
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready playable character sprite sheet for the Brazilian farm adventure Penas pro Ar, in a warm charming pixel-art style.
Create ONE single PNG sprite sheet of ONE named animal character, genuinely transparent background (real alpha, absolutely NO colored backdrop, NO vignette, NO shadows between characters, NO checkerboard baked in).
CANVAS: portrait 1024 x 1536. EXACTLY TWELVE separate full-body sprite frames arranged in FOUR rows and THREE columns with wide, completely transparent gutters. Read the reference only as pixel-art style and layout guidance; it is not the character to copy.
Row 1: facing DOWN toward viewer. Row 2: facing RIGHT in true side profile. Row 3: facing UP, rear view. Row 4: facing LEFT in true side profile.
In EACH row, column 1 is standing idle, column 2 is walking step with one foot/paw forward, column 3 is walking step with the opposite foot/paw forward. These MUST be distinct stepping poses, not twelve identical statues. All frames use exactly the same character design, consistent natural body size, palette and accessories. Feet sit on the same baseline across each row. Full ears, tail, hat and all feet remain fully visible, with ample padding from canvas edges and gutters.
Style: appealing chunky hand-placed pixel shapes with dark warm brown outlines, limited harmonious colors, bold readable silhouette, friendly expressive face, subtle pixel shading. Looks good shrunk to about 55 pixels tall in a top-down 2D farm game. No photorealism, no smooth 3D rendering, no gradients in transparent gutters. Natural animal anatomy; no human arms or hands. No lettering, captions, labels, UI, watermark or grid lines.
CHARACTER: ZECA, a cheerful plump adult mallard duck farm adventurer. Emerald-green head, chestnut-brown chest, warm cream belly, dark teal folded wings with a blue patch, orange webbed feet, mustard-yellow duck bill. A SMALL battered golden straw farm hat with a rust-red band is his signature. Hat sits low, keeps his expressive eyes visible, and is present consistently in all directions. A small rust-red triangular neckerchief complements it. Compact waddling duck body with short legs; two wings, two feet, short curled tail. Distinguish clearly from the pale ordinary duck in the reference. Warm rustic personality, confident playful expression.
